name: Togetsu Yoru
source:
"Fame brings nothing good with it. You get a bunch of things you never really wanted, and you lose everything you did want..."

An up-and-coming actress and model who primarily works in Europe.
She is a breathtaking beauty with a sharp gaze that always seems to be filled with anger.
She has returned to Japan to promote her new movie.

[From [url=https://lilja-natsuka.frontwing.co.jp/en/]Official Website[/url]]
